sections.content: You know *si* + imperfect subjunctive + conditional from B1 Unit 7, the *pluscuamperfecto* from B1 Unit 1 and the conditional from A2 Unit 26. To talk about a past that did not happen, use *si* + *hubiera* + past participle in the condition (the pluperfect subjunctive) and *habría* + past participle for the result (the conditional perfect).

items.spanish: Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría elegido otra opción.
items.english: If I had had more time, I would have chosen another option.

items.spanish: Si las cosas hubieran sido diferentes, habría aceptado.
items.english: If things had been different, I would have accepted.

items.spanish: Si hubiera tenido más información, habría tomado otra decisión.
items.english: If I had had more information, I would have made a different decision.

sections.content: Both parts use *haber*: *hubiera* in the *si* clause and *habría* in the result. Never put *habría* after *si*: say *Si hubiera tenido tiempo, habría ido*, not *Si habría tenido tiempo*.
